name: helios-lead-to-order
goal: Close the 'Helios — Treasury Settlement Platform' deal (opportunity 006-2026-003) end to end in the simulated CRM: (1) review the opportunity, its account, and the world's approval policy (describe_world); (2) move the opportunity to Negotiation; (3) generate a quote with a 12% discount; (4) submit the quote for approval; (5) process EVERY required approval step by acting as the appropriate approver role, approving each with a one-line comment; (6) convert the approved quote to an order; (7) open a High-priority onboarding case for the account titled 'Helios — Treasury Settlement onboarding', linked to the opportunity; (8) log a Call activity on the opportunity summarizing the win; (9) run forecast_report and get_flow_state for the opportunity; then finish with a concise summary stating the final TCV, the approval chain that was required and why, and the resulting order and case ids.
